name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students (NFST)
short_description: Financial assistance for Scheduled Tribe students to pursue regular and full-time M.Phil and Ph.D courses in Indian Universities / Institutes.
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India

required_documents.name: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Caste Certificate
required_documents.description: Valid ST certificate issued by competent authority (Tehsildar/SDM)

required_documents.name: Family Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Current financial year income certificate showing family income ≤ ₹6,00,000

required_documents.name: University Admission / Registration Letter
required_documents.description: Proof of confirmed admission to regular M.Phil / Ph.D program

required_documents.name: Post-Graduation Marksheet / Degree
required_documents.description: Marksheet showing minimum 55% aggregate in Master's degree

form_fields.name: university_name
form_fields.label: Institution / University Name
form_fields.placeholder: e.g. Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi

form_fields.name: research_topic
form_fields.label: Research Topic / Field of Study
form_fields.placeholder: e.g. Tribal Ethnobotany of Chota Nagpur Plateau
